Data stands as a cornerstone in Lula’s value proposition to its customers. Lula serves an impressive network of 800 convenience store locations, providing them with delivery enablement and aggregation services. Their platform’s reporting functionality is integral, enabling customer end-users to monitor their delivery performance comprehensively across various channels.

The decision against in-house development was driven by several considerations. First, the anticipated time to market for an in-house solution was prohibitively long, given the urgent need for these capabilities amongst their customer base. Additionally, the resource allocation required for development, testing, and maintenance of such a system was significant.

“We were acutely aware that diverting our internal resources towards building an analytics platform could detract from our core mission of delivery enablement and aggregation.” - Philip Tribe, Head of Product at Lula
Adopting Explo as their underlying analytics solution marked a turning point in how Lula managed and presented data to their customers.

Overview Dashboard: This dashboard serves as the executive summary, offering a high-level view of overall store performance. Key metrics such as total sales, average delivery times, and customer satisfaction scores are presented in a clear, digestible format, enabling quick assessment and decision-making.
Operations Dashboard: This dashboard tracks efficiency, delivery performance, and operational bottlenecks. It's instrumental for identifying areas of improvement in logistics and operations.

Menu Performance Dashboard: Tailored for customers with diverse product offerings, this dashboard provides insights into sales performance at the category and item levels. It helps identify top-selling items and categories, optimizing inventory management and marketing strategies.
